column1: 21074§proliferate§prəˈlɪfəreɪt§If these other quick-growing species of bushes and plants are allowed to proliferate, they harm the eucalyptus in another way, by affecting the composition of the soil, and removing nutrients from it.§如果这些其他快速生长的灌木和植物得以**激增**，它们会以另一种方式损害桉树，影响土壤的成分，并从土壤中迁移养分。§
21075§surgery§ˈsɜːdʒəri§They perform surgery between 9:00 and 11:30 every weekday.§他们在每个工作日的9:00到11:30做**手术**。§
21076§catastrophe§kəˈtæstrəfi§The flood was a major catastrophe, reducing population sizes in areas involved.§洪水是一场**大灾难**，使受灾地区的人口减少。§
21077§overwork§ˌəʊvəˈwɜːk§He has been overworking for two months, and at last he fell ill in the workplace.§他已经连续**劳累工作**两个月之久，最后病倒在了工作岗位上。§改例句：两个独立分句只用逗号连接，补 and
21078§parental§pəˈrentl§The government repeatedly stressed its support for parental choice in the selection of a child's school.§政府一再重申其支持**家长**对孩子教育的选择权。§
21079§various§ˈveəriəs§The professor has studied the languages of various countries.§这位教授研究过**多个**国家的语言。§
21080§sediment§ˈsedɪmənt§There was heavy brown sediment in the bottom of the bottle.§水壶的底部有厚厚的棕色**沉淀物**。§
21081§resit§ˈriːsɪt§The four students resat the final examinations and passed this time.§这四名学生参加了期末考试**补考**，这次都通过了。§
21082§menace§ˈmenəs§Let's look at some of the reasons why back pain is developing into such a unique menace.§让我们来看一看为什么背疼会演变成一种**威胁**。§改译文：menace 是威胁不是顽疾，改为「威胁」
21083§contain§kənˈteɪn§It is traditionally accepted that children's books should contain a few pictures.§从传统意义上来说，人们普遍认为儿童读物中应该**配有**一些插图。§
21084§fasten§ˈfɑːsn§The driver must fasten his seat belt before driving.§司机在开车前必须**系好**安全带。§
21085§establish§ɪˈstæblɪʃ§You may have to establish new eating habits in order to keep healthy.§为了保持健康，你需要**养成**一些新的饮食习惯。§
21086§position§pəˈzɪʃn§The position of women in society has changed markedly in the last twenty years.§在过去的20年间，妇女的社会**地位**有了显著的改变。§
21087§simulate§ˈsɪmjuleɪt§The experiment simulated a natural environment.§这个试验**模拟**了一种自然环境。§
21088§scratch§skrætʃ§There is a small scratch on my bag.§我的包上有一道不长的**划痕**。§
21089§flexitime§ˈfleksitaɪm§Flexitime is one good method to reduce the number of vehicles traveling together at rush hour.§采用**弹性工作制**是降低交通高峰期车流量的好方法。§
21090§assist§əˈsɪst§The Student Union is intended to assist in teachers' work.§学生会旨在**协助**老师的工作。§
21091§illegal§ɪˈliːɡl§The police arrested the old lady for illegal possession of drugs.§警方以**非法**持有毒品为由逮捕了这位老妇人。§
21092§ultimately§ˈʌltɪmətli§The paper was written, edited, typeset and ultimately printed.§报纸经过编写、编辑、排版，**最后**被印刷出来。§
21093§sinew§ˈsɪnjuː§The athletes were so nervous that we could see all their sinews tense.§运动员非常紧张，以致我们能看到他们紧绷的**肌肉**。§
21094§artificial§ˌɑːtɪˈfɪʃl§We use no artificial additives of any kind in our products.§我们的产品绝不含任何**人工**添加剂。§
21095§veil§veɪl§They lifted the veil of this ancient tomb.§他们揭开了这座古代陵墓的神秘**面纱**。§
21096§tend§tend§Women tend to research thoroughly before applying for positions or attending interviews.§在申请职位或是参加面试前，女性**往往**会（对应聘公司及职位）进行全面彻底的了解。§
21097§removal§rɪˈmuːvl§I saw a removal van outside your house yesterday afternoon.§昨天下午我看见你家屋外停着一辆**搬家**卡车。§
21098§parallel§ˈpærəlel§The expressway is parallel to the railway.§这条高速公路与铁路**平行**。§
21099§compel§kəmˈpel§The boss compels workers to spend more time on the job.§老板**强迫**工人花更多的时间在工作上。§
21100§immediately§ɪˈmiːdiətli§You go down to the end of this corridor and turn right. The computer lab is immediately on your right.§走到走廊尽头向右拐，右手边**就**是机房。§
21101§institute§ˈɪnstɪtjuːt§The Language Institute provides student support, welfare and activities services.§语言**学院**为学生提供资助、福利和活动服务。§
21102§serial§ˈsɪəriəl§A lot of people complained that American police serials were particularly violent.§许多人抱怨美国的警匪**剧**太暴力了。§改译文：serial 是连续剧不是片，改为「警匪剧」
21103§oversee§ˌəʊvəˈsiː§You must appoint someone to oversee the project.§你得指派某个人**监督**这个项目。§
21104§reinforce§ˌriːɪnˈfɔːs§Concrete with steel bars in it is known as reinforced concrete.§水泥中加入钢条就成了我们所知的**钢筋**混凝土。§
21105§commitment§kəˈmɪtmənt§This commitment has been clearly defined in the act.§这项法案中明确定义了这一**义务**的内容。§
21106§donation§dəʊˈneɪʃn§The work of the charity is funded by voluntary donations.§这家慈善机构工作所需资金是人们自愿**捐赠**的。§
21107§curious§ˈkjʊəriəs§Further observation by astronomers revealed two curious facts.§天文学家经过进一步观察发现了两个**奇怪**的现象。§
21108§overdraft§ˈəʊvədrɑːft§Some workers have a huge overdraft to pay off every month.§一些工人每个月都要偿还巨额**透支款**。§
21109§optical§ˈɒptɪkl§We'll discuss optical fibres and how they could be used in the future to improve optical instruments.§我们将讨论光纤以及将来如何把它们用于改善**光学**仪器等问题。§

21110§otherwise§ˈʌðəwaɪz§It's a ten-minute taxi ride from the station and will cost you £5, otherwise, you can take the bus which runs every hour and a half from the station.§从车站打车（到这）要十分钟，车费是五英镑。**或者**，你还可以乘从车站出发的公共汽车，一个半小时一班。§改例句：every half and an hour 词序错，应为 every hour and a half；全角￡改为£；改译文：这里 otherwise 是「或者、要不然」，不是「另外」
21111§possession§pəˈzeʃn§It would be a good idea to get some insurance for the furniture and other personal possessions.§给家具和其他一些个人**财产**上保险是一个不错的主意。§
21112§however§haʊˈevə(r)§I feel a bit sleepy, however, I keep studying.§我有点困了，**但**我仍坚持学习。§
21113§retail§ˈriːteɪl§What sorts of shop do you like best, the department store or the small retails?§你最喜欢哪种商店，百货商场还是小**零售店**？§改例句：去掉问号前的空格
21114§cultural§ˈkʌltʃərəl§The exhibition showed some cultural relics of the primeval times.§该展览展出了很多原始时期的**文化**遗产。§
21115§solution§səˈluːʃn§It took time to find a solution to the problem.§找到解决该问题的**方法**需要时间。§改例句：可数名词 solution 前缺冠词，补 a
21116§morality§məˈræləti§Mankind has undergone great improvement in intelligence or morality.§人类无论在智力方面还是在**道德**方面都经历了巨大的进步。§
21117§transaction§trænˈzækʃn§The teller told me that the computer system was temporarily down, so they couldn't do any transactions.§出纳员告诉我计算机系统临时出故障了，所以他们不能进行任何**交易**。§
21118§twofold§ˈtuːfəʊld§There has been a twofold increase in the number of rare birds in the past decade.§在过去的十年，珍稀鸟类的数量增加了**两倍**。§
21119§embassy§ˈembəsi§Your visa application is being processed at the UK Embassy.§你的签证正由英国**大使馆**办理。§
21120§remark§rɪˈmɑːk§Can you remark the differences between the two paintings?§你能**说出**这两幅画的不同之处吗？§
21121§delay§dɪˈleɪ§After a delay of two days, the whole team continued the journey.§**耽搁**了两天后，整个小组继续行进。§
21122§congress§ˈkɒŋgres§The congress called on the local governments to reopen schools after the war.§战后，**国会**号召地方政府重开学校。§
21123§germ§dʒɜːm§The patient had not the strength to throw off the germs that had invaded his immune system.§病人无力摆脱已经侵入其免疫系统的**病菌**。§

21124§fashion§ˈfæʃn§You'll find all sorts of things in the museum: old suitcases, ships' crockery, and classical cabins decorated in the fashion of the day.§在博物馆里你会找到各类东西：陈旧的手提箱、陶制船模型，还有以当时**风格**装饰的古典小屋。§改例句：ships'crockery 缺空格，改为 ships' crockery
21125§splash§splæʃ§I refreshed myself by splashing cold water on my face.§我往脸上**扑**冷水让自己精神起来。§
21126§beforehand§bɪˈfɔːhænd§The experiment will last for one year. Beforehand, several months are devoted to planning.§试验将持续一年的时间。**在此之前**，要用几个月的时间制订计划。§
21127§filter§ˈfɪltə(r)§Workers find that machines work much better if they change the filters regularly.§工人们发现如果他们定期更换机器里的**过滤器**，机器就会运转得更好。§
21128§aspect§ˈæspekt§A great deal of empirical evidence shows that pictures in a book interfere in a damaging way with all aspects of learning to read.§大量经验表明，书中的插图给学习阅读的各**方面**都造成了不利影响。§
21129§objection§əbˈdʒekʃn§If no one has any objection against the decision, I'll declare the meeting is closed.§如果没人**反对**这个决议，那么我将宣布会议结束。§
21130§tunnel§ˈtʌnl§The prisoner had escaped by tunnelling.§犯人**挖地道**逃跑了。§
21131§contrast§ˈkɒntrɑːst§This white peak contrasts finely with the blue sky.§这座雪白的山峰同蔚蓝的天空**交相辉映**。§

21132§effect§ɪˈfekt§The report suggests that the smoke experienced by many people in their daily lives is enough to produce substantial adverse effects on a person's heart and lungs.§报告指出，许多人在日常生活中吸入的（香烟）烟雾足以给他们的心脏和肺造成严重的负面**影响**。§
21133§distance§ˈdɪstəns§Underground water can flow very large distances and can be kept in underground reservoirs for a very long time.§地下水可以流经很长的**距离**，并能在地下含水层中储藏相当长时间。§
21134§stem§stem§As the axe cut through the stem, the tree fell.§斧子砍断**树干**时，树倒了下来。§
21135§normal§ˈnɔːml§The normal noise threshold for private housing is 55 decibels.§私人住宅区**标准**的噪音音量上限为55分贝。§
21136§sincere§sɪnˈsɪə(r)§My respect to you is very sincere.§我对您的尊敬是非常**诚挚**的。§
21137§summarise§ˈsʌməraɪz§The speaker summarised the important points of her lecture.§演讲者**概括**了她演讲中的重点。§
21138§foetus§ˈfiːtəs§Every brain is initially female in its organisation and it only becomes a male brain when the male foetus begins to secrete hormones.§每一个大脑在结构上最初都是雌性的，只有当雄性**胚胎**开始分泌荷尔蒙时才变成雄性。§
21139§merge§mɜːdʒ§Fact and fiction merge together in his latest thriller.§在他最新的惊险小说中，真实和虚构**相互交织**。§
21140§aware§əˈweə(r)§Most ecologists were aware that the areas of Amazonia they were working in had been shaped by human settlement.§大多数生态学家**意识到**他们研究的亚马孙地区已经受到人类居住的影响。§
21141§label§ˈleɪbl§I think we should label the lid itself and say that it constitutes twenty-five percent of the total weight.§我认为我们应该在盖子上**贴上标签**，注明盖子本身占总重的25%。§
21142§guarantee§ˌgærənˈtiː§The box is made of stainless steel which is guaranteed for 20 years.§这个盒子是不锈钢的，品质**保证**期限为20年。§
21143§interrelationship§ˌɪntərɪˈleɪʃnʃɪp§This study examined the interrelationship between environment and human behaviour.§这项研究考察了环境和人类行为的**相互影响**。§
21144§stationery§ˈsteɪʃənri§They manage the Student Union paper shop, selling magazines and newspapers as well as stationery and sweets.§他们负责管理学生会的报刊亭，销售杂志、报纸，还有**文具**和糖果。§
21145§limestone§ˈlaɪmstəʊn§The limestone has to be dug out of the mine and transported to the power station.§**石灰石**必须从矿山挖出，然后被运往发电站。§
